text:
morgan: Heads-up — planning a canary for routing v2 tonight 22:00 UTC. Need a deploy owner, cohort list, smoke checklist, and rollback readiness. Proposing wedge: 1% global -> 5% mobile (us-west) -> 20% web (us-east) -> 50% all. Thoughts?

tara: I can run the deploy if @jack+@lin ok with smoke ownership. I only have a 22:00-23:30 UTC window tonight.

jack: I can do smoke checks. Will validate routing, auth, and latency SLO for the first hold. Quick checklist: auth health, 200s on /v1/generate, error-rate <0.5%, 95p latency <300ms.

lin: cohort suggestions: start smaller on mobile because mobile traffic is bursty. Suggested ramp timeline: 1% -> hold 10m -> 5% (mobile-us-west) -> hold 20m -> 20% (us-east web) -> hold 30m -> 50%. If any step breaches, rollback to previous step and open convo in #incidents.

jack: smoke commands I'll run (copy/paste):
```
# auth
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.example.com/health | jq .status
# sample gen
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-v2","input":"smoke test"}' | jq .choices[0]
```

sara: quick note on cohorts: can we exclude EU regions for this wedge? compliance wants a separate window. So keep eu-west out of tonight. Also mobile cohort should be users with app version >= 4.2.0.

morgan: yep, exclude EU. add gating: mobile_app_version >= 4.2.0 for the mobile wedge. Good catch @sara.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: deploy/28941 — canary strategy: [1%, 5% mobile-us-west, 20% web-us-east, 50% all]; hold times [10m, 20m, 30m]. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback deploy/28941` (fast rollback will drop traffic to 0%).

tara: I'll kick the deploy at 22:00 UTC. @jack pls be ready for smoke checks at +12m from start. If anything looks off ping me and run rollback.

jack: Got it. Will post smoke results here. If error-rate >0.5% or p95 >350ms, I'll ask for rollback.

lin: one operational note — make sure metrics dashboard query uses the canary routing tag: `route:canary=v2-routing` otherwise you won't see cohort splits.

morgan: final plan summarized: deploy owner tara, smoke jack, cohorts: 1% global, 5% mobile-us-west (app>=4.2.0), 20% web-us-east, 50% all; EU excluded; holds 10/20/30m; rollback `/deploy rollback deploy/28941`. Kicking at 22:00 UTC. Acks? :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup:

jack: :thumbsup:
